# CopilotForge - AI Centre of Excellence

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Orchestrate a business-owned AI Centre of Excellence covering charter, operating model, team, governance, opportunity flow, knowledge, cadence, RACI and value measurement.

- **Layer:** spanning
- **Lead role:** AI CoE Lead
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-ai-centre-of-excellence`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`coe-cadence`](skills/coe-cadence/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Scale, Measure, Improve | Sets the meeting cadence and terms of reference for an AI CoE - steering, portfolio and design review, community and value review - with agendas, inputs, outputs and a decision log, sized to the edition. Use when a new CoE needs its forums set up, when meetings have become status updates that decide nothing, or when decisions are being taken in corridors and nobody can find them later. |
| [`coe-charter`](skills/coe-charter/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Scale | Drafts the charter for an AI Centre of Excellence - purpose, scope across the six pillars, principles, sponsorship, decision rights and what the CoE is not - or the lighter terms of an AI working group for a small organisation. Use when management asks for an AI CoE, when an existing group has drifted into a reporting forum or request queue, or when a sponsor needs one page to agree before people are appointed. |
| [`coe-governance-model`](skills/coe-governance-model/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Assure, Launch, Improve | Writes a proportionate AI governance framework and acceptable-use starter - progressive risk tiers 0 to 4 with minimum controls, a solution register, ownership and lifecycle controls, and reviewer gates - so low-risk experimentation is not blocked. Use when there is no approved AI policy, when departments are building agents with no register or owner, or when governance is so heavy that people work around it. |
| [`coe-kpi-framework`](skills/coe-kpi-framework/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Builds a KPI framework and scorecard for an AI CoE across adoption, capability, portfolio flow, quality, governance and value, each measure with a baseline, target, source and business owner, reported at team level. Use when a sponsor asks how they will know AI is working, when reporting relies on licence counts or hours saved, or when the steering group needs a scorecard before its first value review. |
| [`coe-operating-model`](skills/coe-operating-model/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Scale, Improve | Designs how an AI Centre of Excellence actually runs - the core team and business roles, a central, hub-and-spoke or federated shape chosen by edition, and the flow from intake through the opportunity lifecycle to the right delivery route, linked to the Champion community. Use when a charter is agreed and the CoE now needs people, routes and a workable flow, or when an existing CoE has become a bottleneck. |
| [`coe-raci`](skills/coe-raci/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Scale, Improve | Builds a role-based RACI for AI work across the opportunity lifecycle, governance decisions, knowledge ownership, release and value, with exactly one Accountable per activity and the business accountable for outcomes. Use when nobody can say who approves an agent, when IT is being held to account for business benefits, or when a new CoE needs clear responsibilities before its first steering meeting. |
